about.title: A reliable link between source and destination.
about.description: Our teams and offices coordinate sourcing, purchasing, consolidation, warehousing, freight, and customs support through a clear process shaped around each product, volume, and destination.
about.supportingDescription: Every shipment is handled around the product, volume, destination, and requirements of the customer.
about.trustDescription: One process from source through final destination.
about.imageAlt: STARS team coordinating international logistics operations
about.overlayDescription: From supplier coordination and consolidation to freight and final destination.

why.description: The value lies in having a team close to the source that understands sourcing and freight stages and brings them into one clearer experience.
why.sourceDescription: Legal and operational presence in China and Saudi Arabia, represented in Egypt.
why.teamDescription: More than 15 years of hands-on experience in importing and freight.
why.solutionsDescription: Support for large volumes, cubic-meter shipping, and individual orders.
why.coordinationDescription: Aligned sourcing, consolidation, warehousing, shipping, and arrival stages.

cargo.description: Every shipment moves through a coordinated sequence. From verification at the origin to final freight movement, each stage is handled with clarity and control.
cargo.inspectDescription: Products are checked against the requested specifications before they move forward.
cargo.consolidateDescription: Cargo is received, organized, and consolidated before shipment preparation.
cargo.movementDescription: Prepared cargo moves through the selected freight route toward its destination.
cargo.bottomDescription: Inspection, consolidation, and freight movement work together as one connected process.

offices.title: Close to both source and client
offices.description: Our China, Saudi , and Egypt offices work together to simplify communication and coordinate the import and freight journey.

services.title: Trade, handled with precision.
services.description: From sourcing at the origin to delivery in Egypt, we coordinate the critical stages behind every shipment.
services.importExportDescription: Coordinated import and export services from China to Egypt and destinations worldwide, tailored to each shipment.
services.customsDescription: Support with customs requirements and procedures in line with applicable regulations.
services.warehousingDescription: Receive, consolidate, and hold products in secure company warehouses before shipment preparation.
services.importingDescription: Import arrangements using client or company documentation, subject to applicable legal frameworks.
services.sourcingDescription: Product sourcing, purchasing, consolidation, and supply according to the requested specifications.
services.seaFreightDescription: Sea freight solutions for varied shipment sizes, including cubic-meter consolidation.
services.bottomDescription: Tell us what you need and we’ll help determine the right solution.

freight.description: Choose the freight method that matches your cargo, timing, and priorities. Aseel coordinates the route from origin through destination.
freight.seaDescription: A practical solution for larger cargo, with flexible capacity, consolidation options, and carefully coordinated routing from China to your destination.
freight.airDescription: A faster option for time-sensitive cargo, with schedule coordination designed around priority shipments and shorter transit requirements.
freight.decisionSeaDescription: Consider sea freight when capacity is the priority.
freight.decisionAirDescription: Consider air freight when speed is the priority.
freight.decisionHelpDescription: Tell us about your shipment and we can help coordinate the route.
